title: Latchkit installation update settings v1
description: User-local, per-installation manual/notify/automatic update preference (issue #139), stored beside the activation pointer (`current`) and the launcher ownership record, never inside a project checkout and never once per project. An installation that has never explicitly changed this remains manual: reading a store that has never been written returns this shape with consent.source "legacy-default" without ever creating the file.

revision.description: Incremented on every explicit write. A staged update record's authorizedRevision must match this exact value for automatic-activation eligibility; any settings write (including switching modes) invalidates a prior authorization.

mode.description: manual: check only on request, explicit install and restart. notify: automatic checks with a notification, no automatic download/install. automatic: check, download, verify, and stage while running; activation still requires the installation-wide idle/compatibility gates from later #139 slices.

source.description: legacy-default never comes from a write; it is only ever the value read back when no settings file exists yet, so viewing or dismissing onboarding never opts a user in.
